lead: Squad revive file GUID catalog lookup
question: Can the missing Squad revive file d0a2de18-a7b2-4c3c-9e87-aff6ddc8a180 be routed from a catalog and captured safely?
sourceFacts: No. None of the six retained asset catalogs (Heads 4420709 to 4909067) lists a file with GUID d0a2de18-a7b2-4c3c-9e87-aff6ddc8a180 in any of five string/byte-order forms, nor any GUID starting d0a2de18. The three other unresolved caller-table GUIDs are also absent from all six. Positive controls (DefaultCategorizationTags and GRX_Vehicles) resolve to their expected routes in every catalog. The two selected child export GUIDs are not file GUIDs in any catalog (expected: they are exports inside the missing file).
The capture script takes catalog routes, so there is no route to supply. No Frosty process or capture was started; the capture lock and build record were not touched.
inference: The file cannot be routed from any retained catalog, so no capture was attempted. This is a lookup limit, not evidence that the file does not exist.
unresolved: Absence from the EBX asset catalog is not proof the file does not exist in the game: it may live outside the EBX catalog or in a bundle Frosty does not list.
Catalogs are Frosty asset-record lists, not a game-wide index.
No claim about revive mechanics follows.
Revive mechanics (speed, health restored) remain as already recorded.
reopenWhen: A catalog from a new build or a different Frosty listing resolves the GUID, or the file is found by another route (for example a caller-side path name).
